name: Test record event-marker input
aliases: switchgear Switchgear test and commissioning interfaces
summary: Marks a reference event in the protection or disturbance record during the documented test.
description: Marks a reference event in the protection or disturbance record during the documented test. A test interface separates measurement, command and indication paths so their behavior can be checked in the documented test configuration. The test boundary must show which real equipment outputs remain enabled.

In a switchgear relay panel, test links can separate a protective relay from the trip coils while maintaining the specified current-transformer secondary arrangement. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Test event marker” at the input and “Recorded timing reference” at the output. The marker is different from an operating trip.

Trace the source and destination on each side of the test boundary. Use the selected test-device instructions for actual operations and never infer a safe current-transformer switching sequence from an educational diagram. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
